periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-60 degrees downward-diagonal orientation relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoid configuration with an elongated primary axis approximately 1.5 times the width of the secondary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the geometric mass concentrated in the superior-medial region of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve profile visible at the posterior margin of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Estimated at 30-35% of the total visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing, approximately 1.2 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rufous/brownish discoloration on the ventral pelage of the abdominal region.
